caption: The drawing features two views of the same figure, both a front and back view, set against a plain, light beige background. The figure is a person dressed in what appears to be a baseball uniform. The uniform includes a dark jacket in shades of navy blue, baggy navy blue pants, red socks, and black shoes. The person also wears a red cap with a brim and is holding a black baseball bat. The face of the person in the front view is visible and has distinctive, detailed facial features. The front and back views mirror each other in posture and uniform details, with the bat resting over the figure’s left shoulder in both views. The artist’s signature “W.A. Fletcher” is visible at the bottom right of the image.
title: Baseball Player Coin Bank
